availability_audit: CHRONOLOGY-LEGAL FOR ROUTE 104. ELECTRIKE, SHINX, GROWLITHE, ROCKRUFF, CORPHISH = wild:Route103/land_mons; PACHIRISU = wild:Route102/land_mons. Every member is a base-form wild encounter from a route the player has already walked; Petalburg Woods species are excluded because the woods lie north of this battle. Nothing evolved, nothing fished, no legendary/mythical/Ultra Beast/Paradox species.
plan: REBUILD REASON: attempt 1 lost 3-6. Three of its six members were Fighting types and Hydration Ducklett Hurricane - 100% accurate under its own partner rain - is 2x on Fighting, so it simply swept. Attempt 2 removes every Flying weakness and doubles down on the two things that actually beat this team: Electric damage (4x on Water/Flying Ducklett) and weather replacement. GROWLITHE SUNNY_DAY is the explicit crack-list answer - it ends the rain, halves Surf/Muddy Water and puts Hurricane back to 70% accuracy. ROCKRUFF resists Flying and its Rock Slide is 2x on Ducklett. PACHIRISU keeps FOLLOW_ME on a Volt Absorb body and now carries Thunderbolt as a second Electric lane so the Ditto copy cannot simply out-trade me.
